title: [review] tx_queue.py:407: confirm_transmitted() doe
description: confirm_transmitted() calls _remove_first() which updates stats but never signals the entry's reservation. Callers awaiting a reservation for a packet removed via this path will hang indefinitely. Unlike complete(), there is no reservation.set_result() call.
close_reason: Fixed: confirm_transmitted() now signals the entry's reservation as successful (True) after calling _remove_first(). Added regression test.
